page.overview:
Who is Mike?

"Mike is the top scare assistant at Monster Trucks Incorporated. He assists his best friend and number one all time Scarer, Sulley. Mike is a wise crackin' Micro-car who loves joking around more than he loves working, but together the two make a great team."

He and Sulley make a cameo in Tokyo Mater when Mater drifts out of a building.
